what_this_is: The explicit adjudication record for a mid-cycle revision to this batch's declared surface. PLAN_B11_3.md section 7 bounds the change surface to StylesAndFormulas and/or paragraph_helper.py, the new gate, and the report and registry files. configs/output_retention.json was not among them. This record is what makes the addition a revision rather than a drift.

revision.what: configs/output_retention.json enters this batch's declared surface, and the twelve stage-06 checkpoints of the b10.5 on arm are registered in protected_paths.
revision.authorised_by: user adjudication, this session, on the batch's halt report
revision.raised_by: the halt report's leftover 1: this batch's T1 and T2 read examples/output/b10_5/<sample>/on/work/<sample>/checkpoint.06_styles_and_formulas.xml, and b11.2's T0 registered the stage 09 and 11 checkpoints and the translation tracking but not stage 06.

only_a_path_not_yet_taken.how: nothing in the batch has been pruned and pruning has been opt-in since b11.2's T4(c), so no evidence has yet been lost and no assertion yet depends on the old surface. The revision changes what may happen next, not what already happened.

explicit_adjudication_record.how: this file, plus WAIVERS.md W-B11-10, plus the report section that carries it. The record names what changed, who authorised it and on what evidence.

narrows_only_never_widens.how: registering a protected path can only remove files from what the retention policy is permitted to delete. protected_paths is consulted as an exemption from pruning; adding entries adds exemptions. No threshold moved: keep_recent_batches, archive_patterns and archive_max_file_kb are untouched, and in particular the archive ceiling was NOT raised -- the same refusal b11.2 recorded stands, for the same reason.

registered_paths.both_forms_registered_because: b11.2 registered both forms for stages 09 and 11 and the class is kept symmetric. This batch reads the xml, which is the round-trip form; the json is the inspection form a later reader may reach for.

exit_condition: the same as the class b11.2 wrote: an entry comes out when the batch that named this run as its baseline is delivered and nothing points at it any more.
